image_description: A low-angle, close-up shot of a traffic light against a twilight blue sky. The traffic light housing is dark and silhouetted. Two lights are illuminated: the top red light and the middle amber/yellow light. The red light shows a distinct arrow pattern or internal reflection structure, while the amber light appears as a solid glow. Large visors (hoods) extend over each lens. A mounting pole or bracket structure is visible on the left side.

The bottom (green) lens area is very dark and lacks sharp definition compared to the lit lenses. This is likely due to lighting/exposure rather than generation failure, but edge softness is noticeable.
